open_points.subject: ServiceExit
open_points.text: A8 decides what each means and its status.
open_points.question: What terminal process condition selects each of `start_failed`, `served` and `server_failed`, including whether a clean stop before serving any request counts as `served` or `server_failed`?
options: `start_failed` means startup never completed; `served` means every clean shutdown after startup; `server_failed` means every failure after startup.
`start_failed` means startup never completed; `served` requires that the service actually handled work; a clean stop after startup but before handling work is `server_failed`.
`start_failed` covers any failure before the first handled request; `served` covers clean termination after handling work; `server_failed` covers abnormal termination after handling work.
open_points.default_guess: Treat `start_failed` as failure before startup completes, `served` as any clean shutdown after startup completes, and `server_failed` as abnormal termination after startup completes.

witness.initial: The service has completed startup but has not handled a request.
events: The service process is stopped cleanly by its operator.
outcomes: The process selects `served` because startup completed and shutdown was clean.
The process selects `server_failed` because no request was served.
witness.observer: The process supervisor and operator observing the terminal member and resulting exit status.
